consequences.engine: This system will place live orders with {investment} {quote} of real funds.
consequences.paper: This is a paper bot; no real funds are used.
consequences.pionex: A bot will be created on Pionex with {investment} {quote} invested. You can view and manage it in the Pionex app.

consequences.cancelOrders: All open orders will be canceled.
consequences.futuresGrid: All grid orders will be canceled and the position closed at the best market price.
consequences.futuresGridClosing: The limit take-profit/stop-loss has triggered but its closing order has not filled. Stopping cancels that limit order and closes the position at market price, which may be worse than the limit price.
consequences.gridKeep: All grid orders will be canceled; the {base} held stays in your account.
consequences.gridSell: All grid orders will be canceled and the {base} held will be sold for {quote} at market price.
consequences.keepPosition: Stopping cancels all open orders; the position stays in your account with no take-profit / stop-loss protection.
consequences.closePosition: Stopping cancels all open orders and closes the position at market.

engine.description: Run and simulated by this system's server; the bot stops if the server stops
engine.label: This system

pionex.description: Run by Pionex on the exchange 24/7; visible and manageable in the Pionex app
pionex.label: Pionex

ai.effortHelper: Deeper is more accurate but slower and uses more cost or subscription quota
ai.guardHelper: Enforced by the system, not by the AI
ai.guidelineHelper: Tell the AI your style and risk tolerance, up to 2000 characters
ai.guidelinePlaceholder: For example: conservative, hold when the trend is unclear; exit when a trade loses more than 3%
ai.hint: At each candle close the system gives Claude multi-interval candles, indicators, the order book, the position and recent decisions; Claude can only return open, close or hold. Every order still passes the bot budget and risk checks.
ai.intervalHelper: Decides once per candle close; shorter intervals cost more
ai.maxOrderAmountHelper: Most the AI can open in one order (notional)
ai.monthlyCostLimitHelper: Stops the bot once this month's (UTC) cost reaches it

claude_api.label: Claude API (billed per API key)
claude_api.description: The server calls Claude with your bound API key, billed by usage and capped by the monthly cost limit.

claude_code.label: Claude Code (subscription)
claude_code.description: Decided by the Claude Code signed in on your computer, using your subscription at no extra cost, and orders are placed automatically. If your computer is off or Claude Code is unavailable, the bot only holds.

futures.hint: The futures version simulates isolated margin: the investment is margin, and order and safety amounts are position notional (up to investment × leverage). When short, the price direction of safety orders, take profit and stop loss is reversed.

futuresGrid.checkLiquidationDown: Est. lower liquidation price {price} ({distance} from current)
futuresGrid.checkLiquidationUp: Est. upper liquidation price {price} ({distance} from current)
futuresGrid.checkNote: Official Pionex estimate; no order is placed. The actual liquidation price moves with fills and funding.
futuresGrid.extraMarginHelper: Not traded by the grid; only pushes the liquidation price further away

lossStopHelper.long: Stops and closes when the price falls to this; by amount, when the loss reaches it; by ratio, when the loss reaches this percent of the investment
lossStopHelper.no_trend: Lower stop loss: stops and closes when the price falls to this; by amount, when the loss reaches it; by ratio, when the loss reaches this percent of the investment
lossStopHelper.short: Stops and closes when the price rises to this; by amount, when the loss reaches it; by ratio, when the loss reaches this percent of the investment

futuresGrid.lossStopHighHelper: Stops the neutral grid and closes when the price rises to this
futuresGrid.lossStopLimitHighHelper: When a neutral grid rises to the upper stop loss, closes with a limit order at this price

profitStopHelper.long: Stops and closes when the price rises to this; by amount, when the profit reaches it; by ratio, when the profit reaches this percent of the investment
profitStopHelper.no_trend: Neutral grids can only take profit by amount or ratio
profitStopHelper.short: Stops and closes when the price falls to this; by amount, when the profit reaches it; by ratio, when the profit reaches this percent of the investment

form.futuresStrategyPaperOnly: Futures DCA / indicator / webhook bots are paper only. For live trading, use a Signal bot so TradingView triggers Pionex directly, or create an official futures bot in the Pionex app.

grid.stopLimitHelper: Once triggered, closes with a limit order at this price; it won’t fill until the price gets there

form.investmentHelper: The bot can only use this amount
form.liveFuturesGridNote: A live futures grid creates a Pionex futures grid bot with its own position and margin, visible and manageable in the Pionex app. Your futures account needs enough USDT.
form.liveGridNote: A live grid creates a Pionex grid bot, which you can also view and manage in the Pionex app.
form.maxOrderAmountHelper: Opening orders above this amount are skipped; closing orders are not limited

signal.hint: Starting the bot creates a dedicated Pionex custom signal and copy bot. TradingView alerts go straight to Pionex, not through this system, so server downtime doesn't affect it.
signal.leverageMax: Up to {max}x for this symbol; Pionex recommends at most 10x for signal bots
signal.stopLossHelper: Pionex closes when the loss reaches this share of the investment
signal.takeProfitHelper: Pionex closes when the profit reaches this share of the investment

webhook.orderAmount: Buy amount when the signal has none

form.localLiveNote: This bot runs on your local biru-api: while biru-api is off or your computer sleeps it makes no decisions and does not check stop-loss / take-profit, which only run at the market price once it restarts. Create live bots that need constant protection in production.
form.futuresAiLiveNote: Live trading places orders in your Pionex futures account. The pair must have no position or open orders before starting, and starting sets it to isolated margin with the bot's leverage. Don't trade this pair manually on Pionex while the bot runs; it stops if the position no longer matches.

futuresGridOperation.confirmHint: Check passed. Press "Execute" again to send it to Pionex.

descriptions.addMargin: Move funds from the futures account into this bot as margin; pushes the liquidation price further away.
descriptions.invest: Add investment; Pionex tops up the position and orders at the current price.
descriptions.pause: Once paused, the bot cancels all open orders and stops trading but keeps its position, so the estimated liquidation price will change.
descriptions.range: Change the range and grid count; the investment stays the same.
descriptions.reduce: Reduce the position in units of the per-grid size; the reduced part realizes PnL.
descriptions.reduceMargin: Move spare margin back to the futures account; brings the liquidation price closer.
descriptions.reinvest: Folds the current floating profit into the investment and keeps running. No new funds are added; the price range and grid count stay the same. Floating profit must be above 0.
descriptions.resume: Resume refilling orders; optionally only when the price reaches a level.
descriptions.stops: Change or clear take profit and stop loss; leave a field empty to clear it.

futuresGridOperation.stopLossEnabled: Allow stop-loss to trigger while paused

typeDescriptions.dca: Averages down in steps, takes profit, then starts the next cycle.
typeDescriptions.grid: Buys low and sells high within a range, suited to sideways markets. Live grids run on Pionex.
typeDescriptions.indicator: Buys and sells on technical indicator conditions.
typeDescriptions.webhook: Trades on external signals such as TradingView alerts.
typeDescriptions.futures_grid: Leveraged long, short or neutral grid within a price range. Live bots run on Pionex futures grid.

typeDescriptions.ai: Claude decides to open, close or hold at each candle close; orders still respect the bot budget, per-order cap, stop loss and take profit.

setup.connect: On the first run it opens this admin page automatically. Check the code and press Confirm to connect; nothing else is needed afterwards. If the connection ever becomes invalid, it reconnects the same way.
setup.safety: The agent only returns decisions; the backend places orders from them, within the per-order limit, stop-loss / take-profit and max daily loss. If the agent stops, the bot only holds — it does not close or stop, and the backend still enforces stop-loss / take-profit.
setup.start: Run this in a terminal in the biru-api folder. It prints a status line every minute; press Ctrl+C to stop. Closing the terminal tab also stops it:
setup.title: Decide with Claude Code
